{{Quote|I thought Q-7N was the only droid who guarded this fortress!"<br />"K-Klik! You thought wrong!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the Sith battle droid|<ref name="Star Wars Missions 1: Assault on Yavin Four">''[[Star Wars Missions 1: Assault on Yavin Four]]''</ref>}}
'''Malagarr battle droids''' were used as [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to protect [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] treasure in the numerous [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] temples. They had three arms, with each wielding a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] a [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel soldier]] chanced upon several of them, and later, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] destroyed one.
